name: Lyset Core
source:
Lyset Core is a horror visual novel set in a steampunk universe. 

Young Lyset finds herself wandering through a mysterious world of sentient machines. In her desperate search for her long-lost brother, she must choose between death and immortality.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3812650/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Lyset Core》是一部以蒸汽朋克宇宙为背景的恐怖视觉小说。

年轻的莱塞特发现自己在一个充满感知机器的神秘世界中徘徊。在她绝望地寻找失散多年的兄弟时，她必须在死亡和永生之间做出选择。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3812650/]Steam[/url]]
